errors.when: HTTP 502 run_failed; Chat stream {"error":…} data frame; Responses response.failed; Anthropic event: error
HTTP 200 with null content, no tool calls, finish_reason stop (bus overflow, idempotent replay, or a truly empty answer)

HTTP 401/403 with {"detail":…}: invalid_api_key, api_key_inactive, api_key_expired, api_key_actor_not_found, api_key_actor_disabled, missing_scope, identity_denied, identity_unsupported_platform, compat_api_not_enabled
HTTP 429: rate_limit_exceeded (request rate, concurrency, in-flight idempotency) or insufficient_quota; carries retryAfterSeconds
HTTP 422 response_format_not_satisfied after server-side repair attempts
HTTP 400/404/422 other than the above; client-side validation (http image URL, more than 10 images, unsupported MIME type, unsupported option)
